title: UK Student Visa Success Rate for Nepali Students
excerpt: What is the real UK student visa success rate for Nepali students? See the latest grant figures, why applications are refused and how to strengthen yours for 2027.

What Is the UK Student Visa Success Rate for Nepal?

Industry analysis of Home Office data reported a grant rate of about 94% for Nepalese main applicants in the second quarter of 2025. Put simply, most Nepalese students who apply with a genuine offer and complete paperwork do receive a visa. This is a reported figure for one quarter, so it will move over time.

📊
Why the number mattersThe Home Office now rates universities by visa refusal rates. A refusal rate under 4% is rated green, while 5% or more is rated red, with limits on recruitment. Universities therefore screen applications more carefully than before.

Why Student Visas Get Refused

  • Funds not held for 28 days: money must sit in the account for 28 consecutive days before you apply.
  • Unclear source of funds: large unexplained deposits or the wrong type of account.
  • Weak study story: you cannot explain why this course, university and country.
  • Document mismatch: dates, names or amounts differ between papers.
  • Poor credibility interview answers: vague or rehearsed replies about your course and plans.
  • Gaps in study or work: long gaps with no explanation.

How to Strengthen Your Application for 2027

  1. Choose a course that matches your backgroundA clear academic progression is easier to justify than a sudden change of field.
  2. Show clean, traceable fundsMaintenance funds are £1,171/£1,529 per month now, rising to £1,203/£1,570 from 30 November 2026, for up to nine months. Keep the money in the account for 28 days.
  3. Pay your CAS deposit on timeUniversities set the deposit, often £4,000 or a percentage of tuition. Keep receipts.
  4. Prepare your study storyKnow your course modules, university and career plan, and why the UK.
  5. Submit accurate, consistent documentsCheck every date and name across all papers before uploading.

What If Your Visa Is Refused?

You will receive a refusal letter explaining the reasons. Many student refusals have no right of appeal, so the usual path is to fix the problem and reapply. The Immigration Health Surcharge is refunded on refusal, but the visa fee is not.

⚠️
Never submit false documentsFake bank statements or certificates can lead to a ban of up to ten years. A genuine, well-prepared application is always the safer route.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is the UK student visa easy to get from Nepal?
Most genuine applicants with a valid offer and clear funds are approved. Careful preparation is what separates approvals from refusals.
How long does a UK student visa take?
Standard decisions often take around three weeks from your biometrics appointment, though times vary.
Can I reapply after a refusal?
Yes. Fix the reasons in the refusal letter and reapply with stronger evidence.
